title: Five-minute landmark model for intraoperative hypotension: reproducibility materials
description: Reproducibility materials for a frozen ridge-logistic five-minute landmark model developed in INSPIRE and externally evaluated without model updating in MOVER. The release contains code, model and preprocessing metadata, protocol materials, synthetic numerical verification, 19 non-patient-level aggregate source-data CSV files, and programmatically generated figures. It excludes source data and patient-level derivatives.
